summary: Frontend-only regression smoke after app-wide _app/_document/i18n multilingual SSR change. Verified: home (/), /fees EN + /fees?lang=fr (SSR French incl. FAQ), /help-support (8 article cards + working links), article page body renders full content, /help-support/api-and-integrations?lang=de (German SSR body, <html lang=de>), header language switcher (EN->ES updates all visible text client-side), and 2-step merchant login reaching /dashboard. Also curl-verified server HTML: <html lang> correct per ?lang, self-referential canonical + 6 hreflang + x-default on /fees?lang=fr, FAQPage/Service/Offer JSON-LD present, and localized canonical on the DE article. ZERO console errors and ZERO React hydration warnings on /, /fees, /fees?lang=fr, /help-support and article pages. No blocking regressions found.

ui_bugs.issue: Article H1 sits under the sticky header at initial paint (title visually clipped/faded behind nav at scrollTop=0) — needs top padding/scroll-margin

integration_issues.issue: Switching language in the nav does not add ?lang=xx to the URL, so canonical/hreflang stay pointed at the previous locale and the localized view is not shareable/linkable. Functionally fine (text + document.documentElement.lang update, no crash).

localStorage lang=de causes the plain (no ?lang) URL to re-render in German after hydration while server HTML/canonical are EN. No hydration error observed (i18n switch happens post-mount), but SSR HTML and post-hydration content differ in language for returning visitors — confirm this is intended.

On ?lang=de/fr the article <title>, meta description and H1 remain English (no 'title' key in langs/locales/*/helpAndSupport.json articles.<slug>), producing mixed-language localized pages under a localized canonical — weak hreflang signal.

issues: Article body constrained to a ~620px card on the left with ~60% of the viewport empty on the right — no TOC/related-articles/centered layout
Body paragraph text rgb(113,113,122) on white (~4.0:1) is borderline for WCAG AA on 14-15px text

action_items: Add localized 'title'/'description' keys for help articles (or drop the localized canonical for untranslated metadata) so ?lang=xx articles are fully translated
Append ?lang=xx to the URL (shallow router replace) when the nav language switcher is used, so canonical/hreflang and shareable links match the rendered locale
Fix help-article H1 clipping under the sticky header and widen/center the article layout; darken body text for contrast
critical_code_review_comments: hreflang alternates are emitted as hrefLang="..." in the raw server HTML — HTML attribute names are case-insensitive so crawlers are fine, but verify it is next/head output and not a raw string injection

No article links exist in the SSR HTML source of /help-support (cards are rendered client-side/JS-driven anchors appear only after hydration) — crawl depth to the 8 new articles depends on JS; consider server-rendered <a href> cards plus sitemap entries

rca_of_the_issue: No regression from the _app/_document/i18n SSR changes: per-request cloned i18n instance + fs-loaded resources render correct translated HTML with correct <html lang>, and client hydration picks the same locale with no mismatch warnings. Remaining findings are SEO polish (untranslated article metadata, URL not updated on client switch) and help-article layout/contrast.
